analysis_timing: post hoc analysis; frozen launch protocol remains separate

budget.source: sum of actual completed audit epochs; in-flight work is excluded

evaluation.denominator_rule: Only actual completed episode records from preregistered seeds in each selected evaluator output; unfinished episodes excluded; complete and partial duplicate outputs are not pooled. Additional seeds remain separate per-seed rows.
evaluation.first_success_rule: Conditional on ever-successful completed episodes; failed episodes are excluded, never encoded as zero seconds or timeout times.
evaluation.interval_rule: Two-sided 95% Wilson score intervals over episode counts. Descriptive only: vector environments and episodes share policy/seeds; intervals do not quantify training-seed variability.

limits: Equal environment transitions do not equal identical PPO batches or optimizer updates.
One training seed in each protocol cannot establish seed robustness.
Missing milestones have zero observed episodes and null rates, not zero success.
matched_transition_comparison.pooling_rule: No episode pooling across protocols, checkpoints or training runs.

limits: Logged finite loss arrays do not prove all gradients or applied updates finite.
Actual Adam.step calls and GradScaler skips are observations, not inferred successful learning.
CUDA allocator peaks omit simulator/graphics memory; whole-GPU NVML is reported separately.

scientific_limits: 32-env/400-epoch protocol is not G2 seed-only replication.
Capacity/monitoring interruption is not scientific evidence of learning failure.
Unreached checkpoint evaluations remain missing with null rates.
G2 episodes are historical context only and are not added to any G3C-R2 denominator.
No training seed1/2 robustness assessment follows from seed0 observations.

supervision.coverage_note: A gap remains an evidence gap even when free memory is above the floor; sampled intervals are not continuous measurement.
supervision.extrema_scope: observed samples only; scheduling/measurement gaps may hide extrema

guard.coverage_note: Sampled coverage: regular intervals are not continuous measurement.

training.gradient_note: Finite logged losses do not prove finite applied gradients. Report gradient/AMP observations separately from the observer evidence.
training.timing_note: Total PPO time = rollout/inference + optimization. Process wall includes startup, initialization, checkpoint I/O, shutdown and monitoring overhead. Neither is the policy's simulated elapsed time.
